definitions.explanation: A favorable moment or situation to do something; an opportunity.

examples.japanese: {呑気|のんき}に{構|かま}えていたら、チャンスを{逃|のが}してしまった。
examples.english: By being too carefree, I missed the chance.

examples.japanese: これは{大|おお}きなチャンスだ。

examples.english: To make the most of an opportunity.

examples.japanese: もう{一度|いちど}チャンスをください。
examples.english: Please give me one more chance.

notes:
From English "chance."

COMMON PATTERNS:
・チャンスを{逃|のが}す (to miss a chance)
・チャンスを{活|い}かす (to make use of a chance)
・チャンスを{掴|つか}む (to seize a chance)
・チャンスを{与|あた}える (to give a chance)
・{一度|いちど}のチャンス (one chance)
・{最後|さいご}のチャンス (last chance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・チャンス vs. {機会|きかい}
  - チャンス: casual, often implies a rare or favorable moment
  - {機会|きかい}: more formal, general word for opportunity
